**Exact Results for Perturbative Chern-Simons Theory with Complex Gauge Group**

*Tudor Dimofte,1 Sergei Gukov,1,2 Jonatan Lenells,3 and Don Zagier4,5*

61 pp, 16 sections.

**Abstract.** We develop several methods that allow us to compute all-loop partition functions in perturbative Chern-Simons theory with complex gauge group GC, sometimes in multiple ways. In the background of a non-abelian irreducible ﬂat connection, per- turbative GC invariants turn out to be interesting topological invariants, which are very diﬀerent from ﬁnite type (Vassiliev) invariants obtained in a theory with compact gauge group G. We explore various aspects of these invariants and present an example where we compute them explicitly to high loop order. We also introduce a notion of “arithmetic TQFT” and conjecture (with supporting numerical evidence) that SL(2, C) Chern-Simons theory is an example of such a theory. CALT-68-2716

**Outline.** Front matter; 2 Perturbation theory around a non-trivial fla; 2.1 Feynman diagrams and arithmetic TQFT; 2.2.1 Analytic continuation; 2.2.2 A hierarchy of differential equations; 2.3 Classical and quantum symmetries; 2.4 Brane quantization; 3.1 Ideal triangulations of hyperbolic 3-manif; 3.3 Quantum dilogarithm; 4 Examples and computations; 4.1 Numerical verification of the arithmeticit; 4.2.1 Quantization; Geometric branch; Conjugate branch; Abelian branch; 4.2.2 State integral model
